sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: Meteosat 氣象衛星
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付帶取得時間的雲體軌跡、斜率表與需人工複查的片段。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver acquisition-timed cloud tracks, rate tables and intervals requiring review.
related.difference: 用連續雲圖做平面風場教學估計，量化時間間距與影像配準對速度的影響。
related.differenceEn: Estimate planar cloud motion and quantify the effect of frame spacing and registration on velocity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算 0–5、5–10 與 0–10 min 三段斜率並畫亮溫折線。
先把 18 km 與 15 min 轉 SI，再傳播兩個獨立位置誤差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate rates over 0–5,5–10 and 0–10 min and plot the temperature series.
Convert 18 km and 15 min to SI, then propagate two independent position errors.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SMAP 土壤水分衛星
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付帶取得時間的雲體軌跡、斜率表與需人工複查的片段。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver acquisition-timed cloud tracks, rate tables and intervals requiring review.
related.difference: 用合成校準線反演體積含水量，量化亮溫誤差與不適用地表的影響。
related.differenceEn: Invert a synthetic calibration line for volumetric moisture and quantify brightness-temperature error and invalid surfaces.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算 0–5、5–10 與 0–10 min 三段斜率並畫亮溫折線。
用 θ=0.1、0.2、0.3 生成 Tb，再反算以檢查代數方向。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate rates over 0–5,5–10 and 0–10 min and plot the temperature series.
Generate Tb for θ=0.1,0.2,0.3 and invert to check algebra and direction.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
